latHint: Think a sizzling dinner with a baked potato on the side.
pivHint: The psalmist says the Lord has DONE it this very day. A chef asks how you like your ______ cooked: rare, medium or well DONE.
winText: You found it. DONE isn't just what the Lord has accomplished this very day. A STEAK cooked all the way through is well DONE.
lossText: The word was STEAK. DONE was the pivot. A STEAK can be cooked rare, medium or well DONE, which means cooked all the way through.
votdVerse: The Lord has done it this very day; let us rejoice today and be glad.
passageText: The stone the builders rejected has become the cornerstone; the Lord has done this, and it is marvelous in our eyes. The Lord has done it this very day; let us rejoice today and be glad.
